Let's decode the given expression: P − Q + R ÷ S X T based on the rules provided.

Step 1: Break down the expression:

The rules are as follows:

· A + B means "A is the wife of B".

· A − B means "A is the son of B".

· A X B means "A is the husband of B".

· A ÷ B means "A is the father of B".

Now, let's break down P − Q + R ÷ S X T step by step.

1) P − Q means P is the son of Q.

2) Q + R means Q is the wife of R.

3) R ÷ S means R is the father of S.

4) S X T means S is the husband of T.

Step 2: Put the relationships together:

· P is the son of Q.

· Q is the wife of R, so R is the husband of Q.

· R is the father of S.

· S is the husband of T, so T is the wife of S.

Step 3: Final relationship of P to T:

· P is the son of Q, and Q is the wife of R, so R is P's father.

· S is the husband of T, and R is the father of S, so R is T's father-in-law.

Thus, P is the son of T's father-in-law, which makes P the brother of the husband of T.

So option (c) is the correct answer.

To determine which number is divisible by both 2 and 5, we need to check the divisibility rules for both:

· Divisibility by 2: A number is divisible by 2 if its last digit is even (i.e., 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8).

· Divisibility by 5: A number is divisible by 5 if its last digit is 0 or 5.

Step 1: Check each number

1. 63840:

o Last digit is 0, so it is divisible by 5.

o Last digit is even (0), so it is divisible by 2.

o Hence, 63840 is divisible by both 2 and 5.

2) 20792:

o Last digit is 2, so it is divisible by 2.

o Last digit is not 0 or 5, so it is not divisible by 5.

3) 37915:

o Last digit is 5, so it is divisible by 5.

o Last digit is not even, so it is not divisible by 2.

4) 37254:

o Last digit is 4, so it is divisible by 2.

o Last digit is not 0 or 5, so it is not divisible by 5.

Final Answer:

The number 63840 is divisible by both 2 and 5.

Option (a) is the correct answer.

The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb and preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Past Indefinite. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Past Indefinite.

In Passive voice, the format is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + was/were + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).

Thus, the format of Active voice is: Subject + V2 + Object.

For example:

The Champions League was won by Real Madrid. (Passive Voice)

Real Madrid won the Champions League. (Active Voice)

questions.question: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct logical sequence. A. It contains high levels of Vitamin A and D. B. Cod liver oil is thus used to treat arthritis. C. This supplement is made from the liver of cod fish. D. Cod liver oil is a nutritional supplement. Options:
questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct logical sequence.

A. It contains high levels of Vitamin A and D.

B. Cod liver oil is thus used to treat arthritis.

C. This supplement is made from the liver of cod fish.

D. Cod liver oil is a nutritional supplement. Options:
questions.solution:
(D) introduces the subject of the passage. (C) provides additional information about the origin of cod liver oil. (A) explains its nutritional benefits. (B) concludes by explaining one of its uses.

The complete sentence: "Cod liver oil is a nutritional supplement. This supplement is made from the liver of cod fish. It contains high levels of Vitamin A and D. Cod liver oil is thus used to treat arthritis."

Thus, the correct sequence is DCAB.

The usage of a "to be" form of verb is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

The Active voice in this question is in Past Continuous. Thus, the Passive voice will also be in Past Continuous.

The format of Active voice is: Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object.

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + was/were + being + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).

Math was being practised by Amit. (Passive Voice)
